purpose: After a valid reduced world image is upscaled into the current native buffer, route cached reduced RTV and viewport bindings to native resolution for UI
original_live_bytes: Both eight-byte vtable pointers must equal loaded ENB base plus their specified method RVAs; the exact 16-byte method prologues are in OwnedRouteProfile.cpp
replacement: PointerPatch CAS to pinned uiOmProxy and uiViewportProxy after both profiles validate; both callbacks preserve the ENB downstream chain
abi: ID3D11DeviceContext COM slots 33 OMSetRenderTargets and 44 RSSetViewports with STDMETHODCALLTYPE/Win64 ABI. Other context instances and non-NativeUi phases forward unchanged.
activation: Prepared at the game device-creation boundary only after a reduced scene, current native RTV and OwnedSceneDomain are configured; UI remapping begins only following a published same-frame native image
lifetime: Pinned callback and ENB modules, process-lifetime hook state; both pointer leases remain reachable while callback code can execute
recovery: If either profile differs, no slot is written. A second-slot CAS failure restores only the first slot if still owned; next-launch SafeMode or disabled patch ID keeps this route dormant.
